Despite attending degree course lectures three nights a week at London University together with the associated coursework and in addition to her full time job at the Public Record Office, Hilary Saw has kept the Belgrave colours flying on the roads, finishing as second W45 in the season-long Surrey Road League.

Not only had our Hilary Saw earned a first-class degree in French, she had defied cancer at the same time as undertaking her studies. She was diagnosed with breast cancer while in the second year of her B.A. but was determined to finish her studies.
